name: Ayasaki Miina
source: She is [url=http://vndb.org/c11693]Yuusaku's[/url] girlfriend. Because she's too young to marry, she arranges with her [url=http://vndb.org/c11695]mother[/url] to live alone with her boyfriend. Because she's still in high school they must keep their relationship a secret. Wealthy and sheltered, she only has female friends her own age. She enjoys cooking for Yuusaku very much and hopes to become his wife someday.
